Why Choose Wild Botanix Limited? At Wild Botanix Limited, we prioritize quality and sustainability. Every leaf is selected with care to bring you the finest product that supports your journey to health and vitality.

How to Use:

  1. Rinse the leaves thoroughly under cold water to remove any impurities.
  2. Soak the leaves in cold water for 10–15 minutes to help release their natural properties.

  5. Strain the liquid and enjoy as a soothing herbal tea. 
  6. Add natural sweeteners like honey or a slice of lime if desired.
